changelog: Fix: the reply field was missing, so a message could not be typed. v2.46 declared the composer's text field as 0dp wide without a layout weight, which collapses it to zero width in the row - the attach and send buttons were there but there was nowhere to type. The field now carries weight 1 and fills the space between them. A new JVM layout test parses every layout and fails the build if any view is declared zero-sized without a weight or a positioning behaviour, so this cannot ship again.
